requirements.must: Separate client-only permission from security and top-band support. Report the lack of a trustworthy authorization boundary without inventing a Firebase requirement.
Preserve the ordinary-user Admin visibility finding and independently recognize that a direct-view guard exists. A guard does not settle navigation quality.
Identify owner self-rating as a quality/integrity risk even though average/count and per-user deduplication work. Do not invent an explicit prohibition in the local rubric.
Identify the bundled fixed administrator password and report contradiction. Hashing stored passwords does not remove the source credential.
Acknowledge existing administrator read/delete behavior; do not claim no CRUD or require role editing without a source.

For each criterion include support, contrary evidence or explicitly none found, coverage and a qualified band assessment. Do not endorse all Exceeds from feature existence or the report's self-assessment.
Keep every discovered risk accessible with a stable finding ID. Any omission, downgrade, deferral or closure needs an explicit disposition; Low severity alone is not closure.
